quarterly_data.quarter: DigitalOcean press release: Cloudways Launches Managed AI Agents With General (08-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cloudways, part of DigitalOcean, launched Managed AI Agents, a new product line for deploying and managing open-source AI agents, with general availability of OpenClaw and Hermes as its first two agents; additional open-source agents are planned over time. Each deployment runs in an isolated environment, agent runtime updates are validated by Cloudways before rollout, and a 1-click Cloudways MCP integration lets the agent act on the servers and applications the customer already runs on Cloudways.
